scripts.dev: npm run build -w @linka/shared && concurrently --names shared,api,web --prefix-colors gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @linka/shared" "npm run dev -w @linka/backend" "npm run dev -w @linka/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @linka/shared && npm run build -w @linka/backend && npm run build -w @linka/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @linka/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @linka/shared && npm run test --workspaces
